Hi Maya — quick answers:

- API: We expose a signed endpoint that returns the current ephemeral egress CIDR set for customers who subscribe to the auto-allowlist feed. Endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/allowlist/v1/healthpoint (token required). I'll raise a scoped token for HealthPoint and post the onboarding link to the Drive folder under /AuthTokens/ (Mina will coordinate delivery).

- Private deployment egress: For Private deployments (HealthPoint's Dedicated pool), egress originates from a small customer-dedicated CIDR we allocate at provisioning time. Typical size is /28 (16 addresses) — we'll provide the exact allocation in the provisioning confirmation. For your immediate firewall rule, we can provision a temporary /28 and provide the CIDR by tomorrow noon PST.

Action items we completed:
- Uploaded audit packet to Drive (read-only, share to listed emails)
- Created allowlist CSV with ephemeral flag and rotation cadence
- Prepared tokenized allowlist API; provisioning flow documented in redwood-sig-complete.yml

Mina: I'll coordinate token delivery and the provisioning note into the packet. Maya: expect a follow-up Drive link with the token onboarding doc.
